description: Listado de calles de Montevideo con información de numeración, significado, tipo, título, categoría y subcategoría is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by Intendencia de Montevideo. Listado de calles de Montevideo con información de numeración, significado, tipo, título, categorías y subcategorías. Los datos se generan diariamente por lo que se tienen los datos actualizados al día anterior. Coverage: Intendencia de Montevideo. The portal files it under the publisher Intendencia de Montevideo. Its tags are Harvest, Vías de Montevideo. It offers 10 resource(s) in CSV, TXT. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
